defaults.motion_elements: the village lights and the falling snow

shots.subject: A snowy storybook village of steep-roofed wooden houses painted red and green, candy-cane striped lamp posts along a winding lane, warm lights on every eave and a tall decorated tree in the round village square, dark pine forest all around
A narrow village street of timber cottages with icicle lights on the eaves, red and white striped posts wrapped in garland, a wreath on every door, glowing lanterns and deep snow on the rooftops

A small red post-office cottage with a round-top green door, a plain smooth red wooden mail chest with no plate, lettering or emblem, overflowing with blank envelopes, a lantern either side of the door and a garland arch hung with lights

An empty wooden stable barn with its stall doors open and the stalls bare, hay bales, red leather harnesses with brass bells hanging on pegs, lanterns glowing on the posts and snow drifting in the yard
shots.motion_elements: the lanterns and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls in the stable yard. The lantern flames flicker gently.

shots.subject: A humpbacked wooden footbridge over a frozen stream, its railings wrapped in warm lights and pine garland, lit cottages on both banks and their glow reflected on the ice
A huge timber workshop building with a steep snowy roof, rows of glowing windows, smoke curling from two stone chimneys, a giant wreath over the barn doors and lantern posts in the snow
shots.motion_elements: the glowing windows, the chimney smoke and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls over the village. Smoke curls slowly from the chimneys.

shots.subject: A long snowy runway lined with two rows of glowing ground lanterns and red and white striped posts, stretching from the edge of the village into the dark forest, an empty red sleigh waiting at the start
shots.focus: the far end of the runway

shots.subject: A snowy village square with a tall Christmas tree glowing with lights and red baubles, a small wooden bandstand wrapped in garland, candy-cane lamp posts and lit cottages all around
A frozen skating pond ringed with lantern posts and strings of lights, wooden benches heaped with snow and a little warming hut with a smoking chimney, lit cottages behind
shots.motion_elements: the lights reflected on the ice, the chimney smoke and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls over the pond. Smoke curls from the hut chimney.

shots.subject: A toy-maker's cottage with two bay windows full of wooden toys glowing warm from inside, candy-cane striped porch pillars, a pine garland and snow heaped on the window sills
The front door of a cottage with carved white gingerbread trim, a red door with a big wreath, two lanterns, a small lit tree in a pot and fresh snow heaped on the steps
A tiny snowy village in a valley seen from the hillside above, every roof outlined in warm lights, a glowing tree in the centre and soft green northern lights across the starry sky
shots.motion_elements: the village lights and the northern lights
shots.ambient: The northern lights ripple slowly across the sky.

shots.subject: A snowy lane through a pine forest passing under a row of giant red and white striped candy-cane arches glowing with lights, leading toward the lit village
shots.focus: the village at the end of the lane

shots.subject: A bakery cottage with trays of cookies in its glowing window, steam rising from a vent in the roof, a striped red awning dusted with snow and lanterns on either side of the door
shots.motion_elements: the glowing window, the rising steam and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls. Steam rises from the bakery roof vent.

shots.subject: A tall wooden bell tower in the middle of the village with a bronze bell, wrapped top to bottom in lights and garland, snow on its pointed roof and lit cottages around its base
shots.focus: the bell at the top of the tower

shots.subject: A small courtyard with an old stone well dressed with a garland and lanterns, surrounded by snowy cottages with glowing windows and icicle lights
A covered loading dock beside the workshop with stacks of wrapped gifts on wooden hand carts, lanterns hanging from the beams, big doors open to warm light inside and snow falling in the yard
Stone steps winding up a snowy hill between cottages, lined with glowing lanterns and small lit pine trees, a lit chapel-like hall at the top
A red and white striped lamp post with a glowing lantern and a small wreath, snow gathered on its cap, a lit cottage window softly blurred behind
shots.motion_elements: the lantern glow and the falling snow

shots.subject: The edge of the village at blue hour, a row of cottages with glowing windows and smoking chimneys, a wooden sled leaning on a fence and a lit pine tree in the snow
shots.motion_elements: the glowing windows, the chimney smoke and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls over the village. Smoke curls from the chimneys.
